display.name: Vanta
display.blurb: Run your compliance program from a session: people and their security tasks, failing tests, controls, policies, evidence, issues, vendors, risks, and vulnerabilities. Authenticated with Vanta API credentials brokered at the egress proxy, never seen by the agent.

cli.doc:
Use `vanta` to work with your Vanta compliance program from this session: people and their security tasks (training, policy acceptance, background checks, device monitoring), automated tests and the entities failing them, controls and frameworks, policies, documents and evidence, issues, vendors and their reviews, risk scenarios, vulnerabilities, connected integrations, Trust Center, and customer-trust questionnaires. Authentication is automatic: the egress proxy injects the organization's Vanta token as `Authorization: Bearer` on requests to api.vanta.com; `VANTA_API_TOKEN` is a managed placeholder. Do NOT set a real token or run any login. A path your profile did not grant is denied at the network boundary, not authenticated.

List commands follow every page and print one JSON array. IDs are Vanta object IDs; dates are ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD is accepted where a date is a filter). Vanta allows 50 requests a minute.

Commands and the power each needs:
  vanta org                                       The connected organization (organization:read)
  vanta users | vanta user <id>                   Vanta user accounts (organization:read)
  vanta people [field=value ...]                  People; filters employmentStatus=CURRENT, emailAndNameFilter=text, groupIdsMatchesAny=g1,g2 (people:read)
  vanta person <id>                               One person with their task summary (people:read)
  vanta people-tasks <OVERDUE|DUE_SOON|COMPLETE|NONE> [taskType...]   People whose security tasks have that status; types COMPLETE_TRAININGS ACCEPT_POLICIES COMPLETE_CUSTOM_TASKS COMPLETE_CUSTOM_OFFBOARDING_TASKS INSTALL_DEVICE_MONITORING COMPLETE_BACKGROUND_CHECKS (people:read)
  vanta offboard <person-id> <acknowledger-user-id>   Offboard one person (people:write)
  vanta set-leave <person-id> <start> [end]       Record leave; no end = indefinite (people:write)
  vanta groups | vanta group-people <group-id>    Groups and their members (people:read)
  vanta tests [field=value ...]                   Tests; statusFilter=NEEDS_ATTENTION|OK|DEACTIVATED|IN_PROGRESS|INVALID|NOT_APPLICABLE, frameworkFilter=, ownerFilter= (tests:read)
  vanta failing-tests                             Tests that need attention, with remediation dates (tests:read)
  vanta test <id> | vanta test-entities <id>      One test, or the entities it evaluates (tests:read)
  vanta deactivate-entity <test-id> <entity-id> <reason> [until]   Deactivate a test entity (tests:write)
  vanta controls [field=value ...] | vanta control <id>             Controls (controls:read)
  vanta control-tests <id> | vanta control-documents <id>           What a control maps to (controls:read)
  vanta set-control-owner <control-id> <user-id>  Assign a control (controls:write)
  vanta frameworks | vanta framework <id> | vanta framework-controls <id>   Frameworks and progress (frameworks:read)
  vanta policies | vanta policy <id>              Policies and their approval state (policies:read)
  vanta documents [field=value ...] | vanta document <id>            Evidence documents; statusMatchesAny= (documents:read)
  vanta set-document-owner <document-id> <user-id>                  Assign a document (documents:write)
  vanta issues [field=value ...] | vanta issue <id>                 Issues; statusMatchesAny=NOT_STARTED,IN_PROGRESS severityMatchesAny= dueBeforeDate= (issues:read)
  vanta issues-due <YYYY-MM-DD>                   Open issues due on or before that date (issues:read)
  vanta vendors [field=value ...] | vanta vendor <id>               Vendors; statusMatchesAny=MANAGED,IN_PROCUREMENT (vendors:read)
  vanta vendor-findings <id> | vanta vendor-reviews <id> | vanta vendor-documents <id>   (vendors:read)
  vanta risks [field=value ...] | vanta risk <id>                   Risk scenarios (risks:read)
  vanta vulnerabilities [field=value ...] | vanta vulnerability <id>   Vulnerabilities; severity=, slaDeadlineBeforeDate= (vulnerabilities:read)
  vanta vulnerable-assets [field=value ...]       Assets with vulnerabilities (vulnerabilities:read)
  vanta integrations | vanta integration <id> | vanta monitored-computers   Connected systems (integrations:read)
  vanta trust-center <slug> | vanta access-requests <slug>          Trust Center (trust-center:read)
  vanta questionnaires [field=value ...] | vanta questionnaire <id>   Customer-trust questionnaires (customer-trust:read)
  vanta event-logs [startDate=YYYY-MM-DD]         The audit log (organization:read)
  vanta get <path> [field=value ...]              Raw GET under /v1 (one page; add pageCursor= to continue)
  vanta list <path> [field=value ...]             Raw GET under /v1, every page, as one array
  vanta api <METHOD> <path> [json-body]           Raw call with an explicit method and JSON body

events.label: Information request comment deleted
events.description: Fires once when a comment is deleted from an information request. Remove the comment from your system using the IDs in this event.

events.label: Information request evidence created
events.description: Fires when a piece of evidence is added to an information request. Fires once per piece of evidence — if several pieces are added in a single action, you receive one event per piece. events.label: Information request evidence deleted
events.description: Fires when a piece of evidence is removed from an information request. Fires once per piece of evidence removed. These `v1.information-request.evidence.*` events belong to the Information Request experience and are unrelated to the `v1.evidence.*` classic audit evidence events.

events.label: Evidence status changed
events.description: Fires when an existing audit evidence item changes status. `oldStatus` and `newStatus` always describe a transition of an item that already exists. See [`v1.evidence.created`](/api-reference/evidence/evidence-created) for the event that fires when an item first comes into scope for an audit....

events.label: Evidence comment created
events.description: Fires when a comment is created on an audit evidence item. Fires once per comment.

events.label: Evidence comment updated
events.description: Fires when a comment on an audit evidence item is updated. Fires once per comment update.

events.label: Evidence comment deleted
events.description: Fires when a comment is deleted from an audit evidence item. Fires once per comment deletion.

events.label: Evidence created
events.description: Fires when an audit evidence item comes into scope for an audit, including when a previously removed item re-enters scope after soft-delete.
